statements.quote: In 2023, TeraWulf dedicated a 2 MW block at Lake Mariner for operating and servicing advanced generative AI/ML compute loads
statements.notes: Allocates 2 MW of existing infrastructure capacity to AI/ML compute; it gives no dollar amount or capex share. It is ambiguous whether this is capital spending on AI or a reallocation of existing capacity. The source slide text has no terminal period.

none_found.reason: no sentence quantifies or attributes operating expenses (R&D, infrastructure costs, headcount) to AI; the cost of operations increase is attributed to depreciation from bitcoin mining expansion
revenue is attributed to bitcoin production; AI/HPC appears only as an application being explored or evaluated, with no AI revenue stated
